# Miux Studio

> Miux Studio is a design and engineering studio based in Bangladesh, working with teams across APAC and the UAE. We build brand identities, websites, and digital products.

## Services
- Brand Design & Identity: strategy, visual identity, design systems, brand guidelines
- Web Design & UI/UX: conversion-focused interfaces, prototyping, usability
- Web Development: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- AI Automation & Systems: internal tooling, integrations, workflow automation
- Ads & Campaign Strategy: creative direction, ad production, media planning

## Engagement & Pricing
- Starter: USD 2,400 per month
- Growth: USD 4,800 per month
- Enterprise: USD 8,900 per month
- Annual partnership: 20% off the monthly rate, billed annually

Every engagement starts with a 45-minute discovery call. Scope is fixed in writing before work begins.
